key_insight: RAD-2 combines a diffusion-based trajectory generator with a discriminator that provides corrective, negative feedback in closed-loop training, enabling more stable, multimodal planning while incorporating reinforcement learning signals.
problem_solved: Diffusion planners for high-level autonomous driving model complex, multimodal futures but suffer from stochastic instabilities and lack corrective feedback when trained only with imitation learning, leading to brittle closed-loop performance; RAD-2 addresses stability and robustness by integrating RL-style discriminator feedback.
method: Generator: diffusion-based multimodal trajectory proposer trained to produce diverse candidate futures.
Discriminator: adversarial critic that evaluates generated trajectories in closed-loop, supplying corrective (negative) feedback and shaping gradients toward safe, robust behaviors.

Reinforcement-style integration: use discriminator signals and closed-loop rollouts to scale reinforcement learning within a generator-discriminator framework, improving stability and real-world interaction performance.
impact: Provides a practical route to scale robust, multimodal planners for autonomous driving by combining generative diffusion models with adversarial/REinforcement feedback—reducing closed-loop failures and improving safety-relevant behavior. Practitioners can adopt RAD-2 to get both diversity and stability in trajectory planning.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: generator (diffusion model) → sampled trajectories → environment simulator → discriminator (critic) → feedback loop to generator.
Before/after closed-loop plots: examples showing unstable stochastic rollouts (imitation-only) versus stabilized trajectories with RAD-2.
Metric bar chart: improvements in closed-loop success rate, collision rate, and multimodality/diversity.
Icon set: diffusion atom for generator, shield/critic icon for discriminator, steering wheel for closed-loop driving
paper_title: RAD-2: Scaling Reinforcement Learning in a Generator-Discriminator Framework
paper_authors: Hao Gao, Shaoyu Chen, Yifan Zhu, Yuehao Song, Wenyu Liu
